content.title: Wilyer Abreu's homer in WBC still has everyone flipping out
content.text: Wilyer Abreu's homer in WBC still has everyone flipping out Skip to main contentAlex Speier | On baseballWilyer Abreu still has everyone flipping out over clutch home run for Team VenezuelaBy Alex Speier Globe Staff,Updated March 16, 2026, 11:24 p.m. Print this Article View Comments14Venezuela's Wilyer Abreu celebrates after he hit a go-ahead homer during a win over Japan in a World Baseball Classic quarterfinal on Saturday. Lynne Sladky/Associated PressMIAMI — The image is already iconic in Venezuela.Team Venezuela is enjoying one of the greatest baseball joyrides in the country’s history. On Monday night, Wilyer Abreu and his squad beat Italy, 4-2, to advance to the final of the World Baseball Classic for the first time — in the process securing a 2028 Olympic berth, the first time the country will compete on the diamond in the quadrennial event.
